verdict.rationale: An external agent can read Brex data through the official MCP server, which can 'manage expenses' and review transactions, and through the Transactions API, which is documented as view-only. Policy-violation data appears via the booking `policy` field. Categorization and policy flagging are documented, but as Brex's own in-product AI agents rather than as an API/MCP write path an outside agent can use. missing for 10: a documented filter for uncoded/uncategorized transactions, an API/MCP endpoint to write categories or GL coding back, a review-queue submission mechanism for agent-proposed coding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
